my_company.signal: October 15, 2026: Notion Workers billing moves from free beta to paid, charging credits per run (~$0.0023/run against existing Custom Agent credit allowance)
my_company.why_new: The tracked subject signaled Workers would transition from free beta to paid billing but did not specify the execution date or billing model. The October 15 cutover (beta/free → GA/paid) is the concrete status flip and execution of a signaled change, which the battlecard's AI-pricing narrative must address. This introduces metered cost to Notion's "bundled, flat rate" positioning against Atlassian's credit-capped model.
